ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is triangle JKL, with vertex K above, J at the lower left, and L at the lower right. Each of the three sides JK, KL, and JL has an identical pink tick mark, indicating that the three sides are congruent, that is, equal in length. The left side JK is labeled x+7, and the base JL is labeled 4x-8. Reasoning: Because JK and JL are equal sides, x+7 = 4x-8. Solving gives 15 = 3x, so x = 5. JL is required, and JL = 4x-8 = 4(5)-8 = 20-8 = 12.
